unique_requirements.requirement_en: Importation of refurbished medical devices (Classes I, IIa, IIb, and III) requires a certificate of good functioning issued by the manufacturer or their legal representative in Colombia, along with documentation required for used medical devices.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 翻新医疗器械（I、IIa、IIb 和 III 类）的进口需要制造商或其在哥伦比亚的合法代表出具的良好运行证明，以及用于旧医疗器械所需的文档。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: Does the manufacturer have a process for issuing certificates of good functioning for refurbished devices, and is this certificate accepted by INVIMA?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 制造商是否有一个流程来为翻新设备颁发良好运行证明，并且该证明被 INVIMA 接受？
unique_requirements.rationale_en: This is a specific requirement for refurbished devices, not addressed in ISO 13485.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: 这对于翻新设备而言是一个具体要求，ISO 13485 中未提及。
unique_requirements.original_text: Se permitirá el ingreso al país de equipos biomédicos repotenciados clase I, IIa, IIb y III siempre y cuando cumplan con los requisitos del equipo biomédico y se acompañen de la certificación de buen funcionamiento emitida por el fabricante legal o su representante en el país y anexando la misma documentación exigida para los equipos biomédicos usados.
unique_requirements.english_translation: The entry into the country of refurbished medical devices class I, IIa, IIb and III will be allowed as long as they comply with the requirements of the medical device and are accompanied by a certificate of good functioning issued by the legal manufacturer or their representative in the country and attaching the same documentation required for used medical devices.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: Manufacturers importing refurbished devices must establish a process to obtain and manage these certificates, which is beyond ISO 13485's general requirements for device maintenance.

unique_requirements.regulation_ref: ARTÍCULO 1o. OBJETO Y ÁMBITO DE APLICACIÓN
unique_requirements.title_zh: 所有利益相关者的强制合规性
unique_requirements.requirement_en: All natural or legal persons engaged in the production, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, use, import, export, commercialization, and maintenance of medical devices for human use must comply with this decree.
unique_requirements.requirement_zh: 所有从事医疗器械生产、加工、包装、储存、分销、使用、进口、出口、商业化和维护的人或法人必须遵守本法令。
unique_requirements.audit_question_en: How does the organization ensure compliance with INVIMA regulations across all activities related to medical devices?
unique_requirements.audit_question_zh: 组织如何确保在所有与医疗器械相关的活动中遵守 INVIMA 法规？
expected_evidence: Compliance matrix mapping INVIMA requirements to internal processes
unique_requirements.rationale_en: While ISO 13485 addresses general management responsibility, this decree explicitly mandates compliance for all stakeholders involved in the device lifecycle within Colombia.
unique_requirements.rationale_zh: 虽然 ISO 13485 涉及一般管理责任，但本法令明确规定了哥伦比亚所有参与设备生命周期中的利益相关者必须遵守。
unique_requirements.original_text: El presente decreto tiene por objeto, regular el régimen de registros sanitarios, permiso de comercialización y vigilancia sanitaria en lo relacionado con la producción, procesamiento, envase, empaque, almacenamiento, expendio, uso, importación, exportación, comercialización y mantenimiento de los dispositivos médicos para uso humano, los cuales serán de obligatorio cumplimiento por parte de todas las personas naturales o jurídicas que se dediquen a dichas actividades en el territorio nacional.
unique_requirements.english_translation: This decree has as its object to regulate the sanitary registration regime, marketing authorization and sanitary surveillance related to the production, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, use, import, export, commercialization and maintenance of medical devices for human use, which will be mandatory compliance by all natural or legal persons who dedicate themselves to said activities in national territory.
unique_requirements.semantic_note: Manufacturers need a robust system to track and demonstrate compliance with the full scope of INVIMA regulations, not just those directly related to their manufacturing processes.
